catches.ctx: Automated configuration of mixed-integer programming (MIP) solvers largely relies on black-box optimization. catches.ctx: Turning an engineering request into a simulation requires consistent geometry, physics, boundary conditions, and numerical settings. Recent agent-assisted systems automate simulation setup, but successful execution alone does not establish whether the specification preserves the intended problem or correctly handles missing information.
